These reduced, adapted fixtures reference a2a-go v2.5.0, rather than output
generated by Gridctl's codec:

- `sdk-1.0.json`: supported and unsupported parts copied from
  [TestContentPartsJSONCodec](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/blob/v2.5.0/a2a/json_test.go).
  Message and task shapes use that release's
  [core types](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/blob/v2.5.0/a2a/core.go),
  with fixed non-secret protocol IDs and the tested role/state enum labels.
- `sdk-0.3.json`: message request adapted from
  [TestJSONRPC_ServerExtensionsFrom](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/blob/v2.5.0/a2acompat/a2av0/jsonrpc_compat_test.go),
  with the result discriminator added. Text/data examples follow
  [TestToV1Part](https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/blob/v2.5.0/a2acompat/a2av0/conversions_test.go).
  Task and file cases are local cases using the versioned 0.3 wire shapes.

Gridctl wraps these payloads in correlated JSON-RPC responses during tests.
The SDK is not a dependency. These cases establish codec reference coverage,
not genuine-agent compatibility evidence.
